basic_details.job_title: HRI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Fellow E, Reader F Posts
basic_details.short_information: Harish-Chandra Research Institute (HRI), Prayagraj, a Grant-in-Aid institution under the administrative control of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, has invited applications for two unreserved faculty positions in Physics. Appointments will be made either as Fellow E (Pay Level 12 of the VII CPC Pay Matrix) or as Reader F (Pay Level 13), initially for five years. A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree with research publications is required. Applications in the prescribed format must be sent by e-mail to [email protected] and must be received by 31 December 2026 (Advt. No. HR

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed format that comes with the advertisement (Application Format for Faculty Position, pages 4 and 5 of the notice). It asks for name, gender, date of birth, nationality, correspondence address, e-mail ID, area of specialization, Ph.D. details, present position and post-doctoral experience, and carries a passport size photograph.
List at least three referees with name, position, address and e-mail ID.
Attach a copy of the Ph.D. degree certificate, the latest Curriculum Vitae (CV) with list of publications, and the latest research plan.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates or testimonials in support of date of birth, qualifications and experience.
Send the application by e-mail to [email protected] so that it is received by 31.12.2026. Applications received after this date shall be rejected.
Ask the referees to send their letters of reference to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] by 31.12.2026.
Persons employed in Government of India/State Departments or Autonomous Organizations under them must send their applications through proper channel. The notice does not give an e-mail subject line.

content_sections.heading: About HRI
content_sections.text: The Harish-Chandra Research Institute, Chhatnag Road, Jhunsi, Prayagraj - 211019, is named for the mathematician Professor Harish-Chandra. Its mission is research and the training of students and advanced scholars in the Natural Sciences and Mathematical Sciences, with particular emphasis on Theoretical Physics and Mathematics. HRI is a Constituent Institution (CI) of the Homi Bhabha National Institute (HBNI), a deemed university.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces two vacancies in total, both Unreserved. It does not print how many of them are for Fellow E and how many for Reader F; each appointment is made either as Fellow E or as Reader F.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens who meet the essential criteria on educational qualifications, experience and age may apply. Age and experience are reckoned as on 31.12.2026. The research topics are Astrophysics and Cosmology, Condensed Matter Physics, High Energy Physics, Quantum Information and Computation, and String theory. For both positions, candidates must have a proven excellent academic record, recognition and reputation amongst the scientists in their area of specialization by virtue of the merit of their research publications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

rows.essential_qualification: A Ph.D. or an equivalent doctoral degree from a recognized institution along with research publications in one of the topics listed below
rows.experience: At least three years post-doctoral experience

rows.essential_qualification: A Ph.D. or an equivalent doctoral degree from a recognized institution along with research publications in one of the topics listed below
rows.experience: At least five years post-doctoral experience OR equivalent research and teaching experience, of which at least three years are at the level of Fellow E (Level 12 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix) or equivalent level in any similar Indian or foreign institution as decided by the institute

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Appointments are made either as Fellow E (Pay Level 12 of the VII CPC Pay Matrix) or as Reader F (Pay Level 13 of the VII CPC Pay Matrix). Allowances as per the rules of the Government of India and the Department of Atomic Energy, residential accommodation on the institute campus and health care benefits as per the rules of the institute shall be provided. All appointments are initially for five years. A decision on continuing appointment will be made at the end of the fourth year, or at an earlier date as may be decided by the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: HRI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties below apply to both Fellow E and Reader F. Research work in subjects relevant to the research areas of the institute. Supervision of research scholars. Teaching activities of the institute. Participation in committees constituted by the director of the institute to aid in its functioning. Such other tasks as duly assigned by the director from time to time, acting in accordance with the Bye-laws and the Rules/Sub-rules of the institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons employed in Government of India/State Departments or Autonomous Organizations under them must send their applications through proper channel. The notice does not give an e-mail subject line.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Appointments are made on the recommendations of a Selection Committee. The committee considers the applications received together with the assessments of the institute's faculty and domain experts on those applications. Applicants may be asked to give one or two talks on their research work and possibly a pedagogical talk as part of the assessment. The notice prints no interview date or venue.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in HRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are two vacancies in total (02, Unreserved), to be filled either as Fellow E or as Reader F.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for HRI faculty posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be received at [email protected] by 31.12.2026. Applications received after this date shall be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for HRI Fellow E and Reader F?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. or an equivalent doctoral degree from a recognized institution along with research publications in one of the listed topics, such as Astrophysics and Cosmology or String theory.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed?
faq.answer: Fellow E needs at least three years post-doctoral experience. Reader F needs at least five years post-doctoral experience OR equivalent research and teaching experience, of which at least three years are at Fellow E level (Level 12) or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Fellow E candidates shall not be more than 35 years of age and Reader F candidates not more than 40 years, reckoned as on 31.12.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for HRI Fellow E and Reader F?
faq.answer: Fellow E is at Pay Level 12 and Reader F at Pay Level 13 of the VII CPC Pay Matrix, with allowances as per Government of India and Department of Atomic Energy rules, campus accommodation and health care benefits.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for HRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format, with the required attachments and self-attested certificates, by e-mail to [email protected]. Referees must send their letters to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] by 31.12.2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: A Selection Committee considers the applications along with assessments by institute faculty and domain experts. Applicants may be asked to give one or two research talks and possibly a pedagogical talk.

faq.question: Q9. Is the HRI faculty post permanent?
faq.answer: Appointments are initially for five years. A decision on continuing appointment will be made at the end of the fourth year or earlier, as decided by the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q10. Can government employees apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but persons employed in Government of India or State Departments, or Autonomous Organizations under them, must send their applications through proper channel.
